{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Blak and Blu; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues-rock sound fits my recent listening, but I would sample it another time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gary Clark Jr. Live; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar-driven blues appeals to me, though I am not choosing a live album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rootsy songwriting interests me, but it is not my first choice this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this because I recently listened to Old Sock and want more of Clapton's relaxed blues sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The singer-songwriter rock fits my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my listening to Hendrix and Boz Scaggs, though I am making only one selection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cheek to Cheek; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal jazz duets are not what I am looking for in my current blues and roots-rock mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Tour De Force: Live In London - Royal Albert Hall; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues performance interests me, but I would prefer a studio album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: To All The Girls...; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A country duet collection is less appealing than blues guitar for this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not in the mood for traditional pop standards today."}
